claims.hypothesis: Is the M87 image a lensed ring around a black hole shadow?
claims.experiment: Fit geometric and GRMHD models and extract image features
claims.result: Crescent diameter 42±3 μas, fractional width <0.5, contrast >10
claims.finding: Consistent with lensed emission around the shadow

evidence.quote: We show that all measurements support a source structure dominated by lensed emission surrounding the black hole shadow.

claims.finding: Consistent with stellar but not gas dynamics

evidence.quote: Our mass measurement is inconsistent with the gas dynamics measurement of Walsh et al. (2013) at the ∼99% confidence level.
